construction: rhythm annotations forward-filled from each change point to the next at 1 s resolution, then averaged into 60 s epochs
value_semantics: fraction of the 60 s epoch spent in AF/AFL, in [0, 1]
prefix_rule: seconds before the first rhythm marker carry no rhythm evidence and are dropped; the analysable window starts at the first marker
npz_note: load with np.load(path, allow_pickle=True); 'af' is an object array of float32 arrays
